title: vyges-events/1.0
description: One structured event emitted by a Vyges loom engine or tool. Newline-delimited JSON (JSONL): one object per line. The `code` and `objects` fields are the cross-stage keys used by root-cause analysis to link an early warning to a late failure.

run_id.description: Orchestration run id (set by the orchestrator / span context).

code.description: Structured message code (e.g. DRC-0142, ODB-0220). The clustering key.

msg_template.description: Message with variable parts masked (e.g. 'net %s undriven').

objects.description: Design objects named by the message (e.g. net:data[3], macro:sram0). The cross-stage co-reference key.
